encounter: E0197 TRAINER_DUNCAN (AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F, Feather Badge, cap 48, Medium)
availability_audit: The Abandoned Ship is reached by Surf on Route 108 after the Balance Badge; battle index window 48-60, floor 48. Every member is gated at 36 or below in pool-48.json: Haunter plus Linking Cord (30), Torracat line (36), Togepi Route 102 plus Shiny Stone (24), AlteringCave_1F (14), Granite Cave Abra plus Slateport Linking Cord (20), Sneasel (14). All precede the first Surf. No legendaries, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species.
plan: Three of Duncan's four are Ghost-types and every one of those three is 2x to Fire, Dark and Ghost, so Incineroar's Darkest Lariat and Flare Blitz and Gengar's Shadow Ball cover the whole back half. The fourth, Mega Machamp, is the one that hits hardest and is also the one most easily blanked: Gengar and Spiritomb are both immune to Fighting, so No Guard buys Machamp nothing against them and only its Knock Off connects. Two constraints I am designing around. Gholdengo's Good as Gold makes it immune to every status move in the format, so Gengar's Taunt and any burn are dead against it and it must simply be killed - Dark and Ghost damage, which I have in three places. And its Choice Scarf carries Trick, so my Assault Vest and Leftovers bodies are deliberately absent here; nothing on this team holds an item I would mind being handed a Choice lock instead. Dhelmise's Anchor Shot traps whatever it hits, so the answer is to kill it rather than plan to switch out of it.
